questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure Service Health
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Service Health: retained event information that can help identify recurring service patterns.
Service Health: a personalized view of outages, planned maintenance, and advisories for the Azure services and regions you use.
Azure Status: a broad public view of Azure health across services and regions.
Azure Status: a notification configured for service incidents, maintenance, or advisories relevant to your environment.
Resource Health: Advisor guidance intended to reduce vulnerabilities and security risks.
